q: What are the hospital operating hours?
a: The hospital operates 24 hours daily. Specialist clinics are generally open Monday to Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM and Saturday from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM. Clinics are closed on Sundays and public holidays unless otherwise stated.

q: Does MEDCARE Hospital have an Emergency Department?
a: Yes. Our Emergency Department operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for emergency medical treatment.

q: How can I book an appointment?
a: Appointments can be booked through the MEDCARE mobile application, hospital website, or by contacting our appointment hotline.

q: Can I choose my preferred doctor?
a: Yes. Patients may select their preferred specialist based on specialty and appointment availability.

q: How do I reschedule or cancel my appointment?
a: Appointments can be rescheduled or cancelled through the MEDCARE mobile application under 'My Appointments' or by contacting our customer service.

q: Can I access my medical records through the app?
a: Yes. Registered patients can securely view selected medical records, laboratory reports, prescriptions, and appointment history through the MEDCARE mobile application.

q: How do I pay my hospital bills?
a: Payments can be made using cash, debit cards, credit cards, online banking, e-wallets, and approved insurance providers.

q: Does MEDCARE Hospital accept medical insurance?
a: Yes. We accept selected insurance panels and corporate healthcare plans. Please check with our billing department for the latest list of panel providers.

q: What should I bring for my appointment?
a: Please bring your identification card or passport, appointment confirmation, insurance card (if applicable), referral letter, previous medical records (if available), and any current medications.

q: Can I manage my medications using the app?
